note: Service: the Law on Military Service and Reserve of the Armed Force (Ley del Servicio Militar y Reserva de la Fuerza Armada, Decreto Legislativo No. 298 of 30 July 1992, Diario Oficial No. 144 of 10 August 1992, amended by Decreto 793 of 2008), article 2: it applies to all Salvadorans between eighteen and thirty, without distinction of sex, under article 215 of the Constitution; article 39 applies it to women 'as conditions permit'; recruits are drawn by public lottery (article 17); 16 to 18 may volunteer. The term of service wasn't found in the copy read (article 40 caps those serving in 1992 at 24 months), so months is null. Whether the draw is held in practice wasn't found. Registration within a month of turning 17 (article 11) isn't held. Read from Justia's copy of the Legislative Assembly's text (asamblea.gob.sv didn't answer). Majority and work: Justia's copies of the Family Code and the Labour Code were read; the Family Code's article 345 is repealed and no majority article was found in it, and the Labour Code's copy held no minimum-age article (the download seems incomplete); the Civil Code and the Ley Crecer Juntos weren't found; both left null.

sources.title: Justia El Salvador: Ley del Servicio Militar y Reserva de la Fuerza Armada (copy of the Legislative Assembly text, D.L. 298 of 1992)
sources.said: Art. 2.- La presente Ley se aplicará a todos los salvadoreños, comprendidos entre los dieciocho y treinta ... años, de edad, sin distinción de sexo ... Art. 39.- Esta ley se aplicará a los obligados del sexo femenino, conforme las condiciones lo permitan.
